page.content:
Warrant officer who survives the Nostromo and returns in Aliens.

How Ellen Ripley connects

  • Creator: Sigourney Weaver — Sigourney Weaver originated Ellen Ripley.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Alien (1979) is Ripley's first survival against the xenomorph.
  • Faction: Nostromo crew — Ripley is warrant officer of the Nostromo crew.
  • Work: Aliens — Aliens returns Ripley to LV-426 with the Marines.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — Ripley survives and later hunts the xenomorph.
  • Character: Xenomorph Queen — Ripley fights the Queen to save Newt.
  • Character: Newt — Ripley becomes Newt's protector on LV-426.

What is Ellen Ripley?

Ellen Ripley is the Nostromo warrant officer who insists on quarantine, outlasts the xenomorph, and later leads the fight for Newt against the Queen.

Key threads lead to Sigourney Weaver, Alien (1979), Nostromo crew, Aliens, Xenomorph and Xenomorph Queen.
